evidence.title: AI emotional support is better only when chosen, but shifts preferences even when it is not

summary: Researchers discovered that AI-driven emotional support tools boost well‑being only when individuals actively select them, but the presence of such tools subtly shifts users' preferences even when they are not chosen. The findings highlight both the potential benefits and unintended influence of AI companions in mental‑health contexts.
title: Study finds AI emotional support most effective when users choose it, yet still influences preferences when unchosen
